blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s net satisfaction rating fell to “poor” in the third quarter of 2026 from “neutral” in the previous quarter, according to a Social Weather Stations (SWS) survey. According to the SWS survey for Sept. 21 to 21, 35 percent of adult Filipinos expressed satisfaction with Marcos, while 46 percent were dissatisfied and 20 percent were undecided with Marcos’ performance as President. His overall net satisfaction rating is -11 percent, which is classified by the SWS as poor, which ranges between -10 and -29. The survey was conducted with a sampling error of ±3% for national […]...
